description: The bar chart illustrates the task count for different language families, categorized by which model performed better. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing language groups ordered alphabetically: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "task count," featuring a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 40 with numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 10, accompanied by horizontal grid lines. The chart utilizes grouped vertical bars, where each language group category contains up to three adjacent bars. According to the legend titled "better," the bars represent three outcomes: "mBERT" in light blue-grey, "XLM-R" in dark blue-grey, and "same" in olive green; all bars are visually emphasized with thin black outlines. Across the categories, the task counts vary. For IE-Baltic, XLM-R is at 10 and same is at 7, with mBERT at 0. In IE-Germanic, mBERT is 4, XLM-R is 18, and same is 22. IE-Indic shows mBERT at 1, XLM-R at 5, and same at 4. For IE-Romance, mBERT is 4, XLM-R is 13, and same is 30. The tallest bar in the chart is found in the IE-Slavic group for XLM-R, reaching approximately 39, alongside mBERT at 12 and same at 28. IE-other has mBERT at 1, XLM-R at 6, and same at 8. Isolate shows mBERT at 1, XLM-R at 5, and same at 1. Semitic has XLM-R at 7 and same at 1, with mBERT at 0. Finally, Uralic displays mBERT at 1, XLM-R at 14, and same at 5. The shortest bars are at 0 for mBERT in the IE-Baltic and Semitic categories.
